authority: USDA Forest Service FIA / Nationwide Forest Inventory
title: Nationwide Forest Inventory
fact_supported: FIA uses a probabilistic plot sample; current NFI page describes about one plot per 6,000 acres, 5–10 year remeasurement depending on State; EVALIDator/FIADB-API produce population estimates and sampling errors as totals (e.g. number of trees) and ratios (e.g. trees per acre of forest land).
notes: Current high-level program description. Exact estimator mechanics taken from S03/S04.

title: The Forest Inventory and Analysis Database User Guide (NFI)
fact_supported: Current TREE.TPA_UNADJ definition and fixed-radius values; current population table names; TPA_UNADJ must be adjusted using POP_STRATUM factors to derive population estimates.
notes: Current frozen-schema authority. TPA_UNADJ exact values: SUBP 6.018046, MICR 74.965282, MACR 0.999188 for mapped design.

title: The Forest Inventory and Analysis Database: Population Estimation User Guide
section: Chapter 3 Linking the Appropriate Tables; Example 3-3; Chapter 4 Sampling Errors; Chapter 5
fact_supported: EXPNS meaning; adjustment factors; official table join path; official total-number-of-live-trees SQL semantics; live tree filter STATUSCD=1; sampling-error implementation.
notes: Operational FIADB estimator source. Example 3-3 explicitly estimates total number of live trees.

title: Sampling and estimation documentation for the Enhanced Forest Inventory and Analysis Program: 2022
section: Chapter 2 Foundational Documentation; Appendix 1 Forest Area Estimation and Area Control Revisited
fact_supported: Phase 1/2 design, hex sample, plot design, poststratification, domain estimator and variance, estimation units, summation across units/States, user-defined GIS polygon domains, area-control options, small-area limitations.
notes: Primary statistical-design authority for D09. States that EVALIDator/DATIM can estimate user-defined populations such as GIS polygons via domains across all estimation units.

title: The enhanced forest inventory and analysis program - national sampling design and estimation procedures
section: Sampling frame, plot design, sample-based estimators, combining panels
page: full report 85 p.; relevant chapters pp. 11–84
fact_supported: Foundational national sampling frame, plot as primary sample location, sample-based estimators, annual panel framework.
notes: Still cited by current 2022 official documentation for foundational methods.

title: Combining panels for Forest Inventory and Analysis estimation
fact_supported: FIA assumes complete spatial coverage for each panel; single-panel estimation follows standard method; combining panels may require method modification depending on how panels are combined.
notes: Relevant to temporal-window and A/B questions, but does not prescribe Q1 half-sample cross-fitting.

title: FIADB-API & EVALIDator User Documentation
fact_supported: fullreport is the primary Phase 2 estimate endpoint; wc is evaluation group; EVALIDator can produce population estimates and sampling errors; circular spatial estimates are supported in current API.
notes: Implementation semantics, not a replacement for statistical theory.

title: EVALIDator wc Table
fact_supported: State EVALID/EVAL_GRP windows differ. Examples: Delaware 102023=2017–2023; Florida 122023=2016–2023; California 062023=2013–2023; Washington 532023=2014–2023.
notes: Direct proof that calendar 2017–2023 is not a single coherent nationwide official evaluation.

title: FIA Glossary: Standard Terminology
fact_supported: Evaluation is the unique combination of statistical sample, target population, and stratification used for estimates at a point in time; EVALID uniquely identifies the population/evaluation used for an estimate.

title: Spatial Data Services
fact_supported: Exact plot coordinates are confidential. Public coordinates are perturbed: most within 0.5 mile, remainder up to 1 mile; some private forest plots are swapped within the same county.
notes: Critical caveat for assigning public FIADB plots to exact 50-km cell boundaries.

authority: USDA Forest Service FIA authors / peer reviewed
title: Post-stratified estimation: with-in strata and total sample size recommendations
fact_supported: Within-stratum sample size of at least 10 was indicated for stable means in tested settings; SE bias at small total n; total n guidance was variable-specific (25 for forest proportion, 75 for cubic volume at <3% bias).
notes: Guidance, not a universal minimum threshold for 50-km species tree totals.

authority: USDA Forest Service FIA authors / peer reviewed
title: Estimation of Forest Disturbance from Retrospective Observations in a Broad-Scale Inventory
section: 2.2 Post-stratified estimator; 2.3 Sampling Weight Adjustment; Discussion
fact_supported: Sampling weights are inverse inclusion probabilities; when effective sample size changes, weights must change. Demonstrates FIA-specific weight recalibration under a panel-derived unequal-probability situation.
notes: Used as FIA-specific support for A/B implications. It does not itself define Q1 A/B cross-fitting.
